n, m = map(int, input().split())

# Read the number n and base m
s = []
t = n
while t:
    s.append(t % m)
    t //= m
num = len(s)

# Initialize the 3D array f with zeros
f = [[[0 for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(65)]
g = [[0 for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(35)]
A = [1 for _ in range(35)]
B = [0 for _ in range(35)]

MOD = 1000000007

def Dec(x, y):
    return (x - y + m) % m

# Base case initialization
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    f[1][i][i] = 1
for i in range(m + 1):
    f[1][0][i] = 1

# Dynamic programming to fill f
for i in range(2, num + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        f[i][j][j] = 1
    for j in range(m):
        for a in range(m + 1):
            for b in range(m + 1):
                for c in range(m + 1):
                    g[a][c] = (g[a][c] + f[i - 1][Dec(a, j)][Dec(b, j)] * f[i][b][c]) % MOD
        for a in range(m + 1):
            for b in range(m + 1):
                f[i][a][b] = g[a][b]
                g[a][b] = 0

# Initialize A
for i in range(m + 1):
    A[i] = 1

# Main computation
for i in range(1, num + 1):
    S = 0
    for j in range(i + 1, num + 1):
        S = (S + s[j - 1]) % m
    for _ in range(s[i - 1]):
        dec = (S + s[i - 1]) % m
        for a in range(m + 1):
            for b in range(m + 1):
                B[b] = (B[b] + A[a] * f[i][Dec(a, dec)][Dec(b, dec)]) % MOD
        for a in range(m + 1):
            A[a] = B[a]
            B[a] = 0

print(A[m])
</translated_code>
